subject: Ownership stand-up + decommission list for stale opportunities
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Tim Hughes <tim.hughes@nimbanalytix.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ownership stand-up + decommission list for stale opportunities

Team — quick ask as we close the month. Finance flagged a ~12% variance tied to 27 "inactive" Salesforce opportunities that still show commit in the forecast. Attached is the export (stale-opps-export.csv) with the key fields (owner, stage, close_date, last_activity).

Goal: by EOD today, we need a one-line owner decision for each row: (1) Keep & reconfirm close plan, (2) Move to On Hold (not in forecast) with reason, or (3) Decommission (archive). This helps us avoid overstating committed revenue in next week's FP&A sync.

Please do not reassign ownership in SFDC without confirming with the current owner. If you are the owner, mark the row and add a 1-line rationale. If you need me to reassign to a CS or Solutions lead for technical validation, flag with "esc".

For context: Tim (Nimbanalytix) is on the thread; they asked for a pullback on any deals we can't actually forecast with confidence.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Sales Ops Analyst, Redwood Inference

--- Attachment stubs: 2028-06-12_stale-opps-export.csv (csv), nimba_ma_plan_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Tim Hughes <tim.hughes@nimbanalytix.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ownership stand-up + decommission list for stale opportunities

Thanks Monica — quick ownership update from my side. I went through the 8 rows assigned to me in the export and my recommendations below (one-line per opp id):

NBX-4301: Decommission — no product fit after last technical review, customer moved to competitor.
NBX-4417: Keep & reconfirm — PO in legal, expected signature 7/2; I'm chasing updated timeline.
NBX-4489: On Hold — waiting on customer budget approval, ask to remove from forecast for now.
NBX-4533: Decommission — duplicate record, merged into NBX-4301; will archive.
NBX-4620: Keep & reconfirm — active POC, but request to reduce commit amount by 35% until POC completes.
NBX-4748: Decommission — no response for 210 days, no activity.
NBX-4762: On Hold — procurement freeze; expect resolution Q3.
NBX-4810: Keep & reconfirm — verbal yes, legal reviewing redlines.

Action items: I will update the Stage/Forecast Category and add a 1-line note on each opportunity in SFDC. Monica — I attached the mini MA plan (nimba_ma_plan_v2.pdf) that I referenced in my notes; Tim, FYI on the ones I'm keeping as reconfirm.

Will follow up once I've finished the SFDC updates (~2pm PT).

— Priyom
Account Executive, Mid-Market
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Tim Hughes <tim.hughes@nimbanalytix.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 13:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ownership stand-up + decommission list for stale opportunities

Good work, Priyom. A couple of manager notes:

- For NBX-4417 and NBX-4810, please prioritize the legal touchpoints. If legal needs a copy of the signed SOW to move, loop in Solutions Eng (cc Ben) and tag as "at risk" in SFDC rather than keeping full commit until signed.
- For any "Decommission" items, capture the last_activity reason in the opportunity comments (who/what/when) so we have auditability for FP&A. Monica, we'll need those notes for the variance review.
- Vivek — if you can spare a quick pre-call with Priyom on NBX-4620 (POC health) that would help determine whether to return partial commit vs full.

Please finish the SFDC updates and respond here when done. If any owner needs a formal reassignment, route to me and I'll sign off.

Lauren Bishop
Sr. Director, Revenue Operations

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim Hughes <tim.hughes@nimbanalytix.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ownership stand-up + decommission list for stale opportunities

All — completed SFDC edits at 15:50 PT. Summary of actions taken:

- Updated forecast category for NBX-4417 and NBX-4810 to "Commit (Subject to Legal)" and added comment linking to legal doc in the record.
- Moved NBX-4301, NBX-4533, NBX-4748 to Closed-Lost and annotated with last_activity and competitor notes.
- Set NBX-4489 and NBX-4762 to "On Hold" (removed from forecast) and added 1-line reason.
- NBX-4620 remains in forecast at a reduced amount (65% of original); added comment with POC health and scheduled a check-in with Vivek on 6/15.

Monica — export attached for audit (2028-06-12_stale-opps-export.csv). Tim — updated numbers reduce projected committed ARR by $136,200 for June; happy to walk through if you'd like.

If no objections, I'll run the archive for the decommissioned dupes at EOD tomorrow to preserve audit trail.

Thanks — Priyom
